blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) will provide security for visiting heads of delegation throughout their stay in the country for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit this month, with troops to be deployed at hotels, roads and event venues. AFP spokesperson Col. Francel Margareth Padilla said the military would work alongside the Philippine National Police (PNP), which is primarily responsible for maintaining peace and order during the gathering.
